claims.source: BDM International, Inc., Schedule 14D-9, filed 26 November 1997, CIK 0000870763, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/870763/0000950152-97-008353.txt
claims.text: TRW agreed to acquire BDM in November 1997: 'on November 20, 1997, BDM International, Inc. entered into a Merger Agreement with TRW Inc. and Systems Acquisition Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of TRW, pursuant to which that subsidiary has commenced a tender offer (the "Offer") to purchase all of the outstanding shares of BDM's common stock for a cash price of $29.50 per share.'

claims.source: Northrop Grumman Corporation, Form 8-K, earliest event 11 December 2002, Item 2, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1133421/000089843002004580/d8k.htm
claims.text: The Northrop Grumman merger closed on a stated date: 'Pursuant to the merger agreement, on December 11, 2002, Richmond Acquisition Corp. was merged with and into TRW, with TRW surviving the merger as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Northrop Grumman.' The exchange ratio was 0.5357 Northrop shares per TRW share.

claims.source: Northrop Grumman press release, 11 December 2002, filed as Form 425 on 12 December 2002, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/100030/000089843002004462/d425.htm
claims.text: The defence businesses were renamed at once: 'TRW Systems will be renamed Northrop Grumman Mission Systems, with about 15,000 employees and headquartered in Reston, Va. TRW Space & Electronics will be renamed Northrop Grumman Space Technology, which has more than 8,600 employees, based in Redondo Beach, Calif.'

claims.source: Northrop Grumman Corporation, Form 8-K filed 13 December 2002, Item 5(b), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1133421/000089843002004481/d8k.htm
claims.text: The merger required an antitrust consent: on 11 December 2002 the United States filed a complaint, a proposed final judgment and a stipulation and order against Northrop Grumman and TRW, which the court entered the same day and which became effective on the closing of the merger.
EDGAR carries the transition on the company's own registration: CIK 0000100030 is listed as NORTHROP GRUMMAN SPACE & MISSION SYSTEMS CORP, 'formerly: TRW INC (filings through 2002-12-23)'.

desc: TRW Inc. is the middle link of a chain the board already carries at both ends. In November 1997 it agreed to acquire BDM International through a cash tender offer at $29.50 a share, and BDM deregistered a month later. On 11 December 2002 TRW was itself merged into a Northrop Grumman subsidiary, with TRW surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary; TRW Systems became Northrop Grumman Mission Systems at Reston and TRW Space and Electronics became Northrop Grumman Space Technology at Redondo Beach. EDGAR carries the same transition on the company's own CIK. Until now the board reached from BDM to Northrop Grumman with no node in between, and the edge was an assertion where the filings make it a record. The corpus's further claim, that TRW was the parent of an unnamed FFRDC that ran the programme for about 29 years, is supported by nothing in any filing opened here.
